notes: Phase 2 findings for future sessions: (1) VPS Caddy systemd 'reload' is WEDGED (state stuck 'reloading' since 2026-05-15, pre-existing) — use DIRECT admin-API 'sudo caddy reload --config /etc/caddy/Caddyfile --adapter caddyfile', NOT systemctl reload. Config persists in /etc/caddy/Caddyfile so it survives restart. (2) Per-site Caddy access-log files must be PRE-CREATED (caddy user can't create new files in /var/log/caddy under the systemd sandbox) — I dropped the log directive for now. (3) Auto-deploy gap: the reusable docker variant runs 'docker compose up' which only builds the BACKEND container; the frontend static dist is built separately (manual now). For push-to-deploy (post OPS-b78), add a frontend container to docker-compose or a dist-build step. (4) VPS runtime secrets: real OpenAI key + boot-safe Stripe/Whop PLACEHOLDERS in /srv/diagnosticpro/.env (mode 600) — real Stripe/Whop go in at Phase 3.
